preconditions.description: The number of testcases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= 10**5 for m in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each testcase has a number of columns m between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a[i][j] <= 10**4 for j in range(m)) for i in range(2) for m, a in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [[list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(2)] for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix contains between 1 and 10^4 coins inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(m for m in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of m over all testcases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(score, int) for score in scores)
all(0 <= score <= 10**9 for score in scores)
postconditions.description: Each score is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(score == calculate_optimal_score(m, a) for score, (m, a) in zip(scores, [(int(input().split()[0]), [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(2)]) for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: Each score is the optimal score calculated for the given matrix.
